linesCarryingConnectionPrereqs.prereqs: Availability: Not stated by Adobe; the integration works once it is enabled for the organization. Prerequisites for Brand Visibility + Customer Journey Analytics: The paid Brand Visibility offering, not the free trial (CJA's page requires it for the source); CDN access logs forwarded to and received by Brand Visibility for each site, and Adobe's confirmation that the site is available in the source; An Experience Platform user who sets up the Adobe Brand Visibility source dataflow in the sandbox used by the CJA connection; each site can be allocated to one dataflow only; A CJA administrator who adds the Brand Visibility dataset to a connection on that sandbox and its fields to a data view; Adobe's managed connector stops at the Experience Platform dataset; A full URL field in the web event dataset that matches Brand Visibility's CDN URL, for the page join; A CJA derived field that groups AI referring domains, for referral analysis inside CJA (CJA Select, Prime or Ultimate; derived fields are not in CJA Foundation); For Business Impact in Brand Visibility: the CJA integration enabled for the organization, a signed-in user with CJA access to the data view in the same IMS organization as the site, and permission to manage configuration in Brand Visibility; A CJA data view that maps Page URL, Referring Domain, Country and Device Type, plus Page Views, Visits and Visitors (revenue and orders optional); Acceptance that some Brand Visibility data is processed temporarily in the Unit
